description: Business days calculator: adds or subtracts working days from a date in any of 220+ countries, skipping weekends and public holidays, and lists the holidays skipped. Local weekends supported (e.g. Friday-Saturday in Saudi Arabia and Egypt). Verified calendars for South Africa and 10 African countries. Useful for payment terms such as 'net 5 business days', notice periods, SLAs, delivery estimates and legal deadlines. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW
